ALPHA GUIDE 
Page 56 of 76 
 
Where does evil come from? 
 
• Triple alliance: 
– World—the enemy around 
– Flesh—the enemy within 
– Devil—the enemy above 
 
 
1. WHY SHOULD WE BELIEVE THAT THE DEVIL EXISTS? (Romans 12:21) 
 
• Scripture: The Bible presents a personal, spiritual being in active rebellion against God. 
– Old Testament (Isaiah 14; Job 1; 1 Chronicles 21:1) 
– Jesus (Luke 10:17–20) 
– Peter (1 Peter 5:8–11) 
– Paul (Ephesians 6:11–12) 
 
• Tradition: Christians down through the ages have believed. 
 
• Reason: It makes sense of the world we see around us. – Why do bad things happen? 
 
Avoid two extremes: Disbelief vs unhealthy, excessive interest
